description: Improve search functionalities by indexing product data with Algolia
name: Algolia

images.title: Connect your Algolia index
images.description: Enter your Algolia Application ID, Admin API Key and index name, and turn automatic product updates on or off.

images.title: Choose what to sync
images.description: Sync all active products or only those created on or after a date, in pages of 10 to 1000 products.

images.title: Stop and resume a sync
images.description: Follow the progress of a sync, stop it at any time and resume from the next page.

images.title: Sync complete
images.description: See how many products were processed and sent to Algolia when the sync finishes.
